findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "social-media-video-downloader" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_youtube_v3_video_comments, get_youtube_v3_post_details, get_youtube_v3_post_comments, get_youtube_v3_channel_posts, get_tiktok_v3_user_details, get_tiktok_v3_post_details, get_facebook_v3_profile_id, get_facebook_v3_profile_details, get_facebook_v3_profile_about, get_facebook_v3_profile_reels, get_facebook_v3_profile_photos, get_facebook_v3_post_details, get_instagram_v3_media_post_details · Public sink: get_youtube_v3_post_details, get_youtube_v3_post_comments, get_tiktok_v3_post_details, get_facebook_v3_post_details, get_instagram_v3_media_post_details.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_youtube_v3_video_comments, get_youtube_v3_post_details, get_youtube_v3_post_comments, get_youtube_v3_channel_posts, get_tiktok_v3_user_details, get_tiktok_v3_post_details, get_facebook_v3_profile_id, get_facebook_v3_profile_details, get_facebook_v3_profile_about, get_facebook_v3_profile_reels, get_facebook_v3_profile_photos, get_facebook_v3_post_details, get_instagram_v3_media_post_details · Public sink: get_youtube_v3_post_details, get_youtube_v3_post_comments, get_tiktok_v3_post_details, get_facebook_v3_post_details, get_instagram_v3_media_post_details

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
